sensor: 8MP CMOS (UVC-AI-Theta-Lens standard lens module); 12MP CMOS (UVC-AI-Theta-Lens-360 module)
features: modular sensor-hub design: UVC-AI-Theta hub + interchangeable lens modules connected by cable
standard lens module (UVC-AI-Theta-Lens): 8MP 3264x2448 (4:3), 24 FPS max, FOV H97.5/V79.4/D118.2
optional 360 lens module (UVC-AI-Theta-Lens-360): 12MP CMOS, 6MP 2560x2560 (1:1) panoramic, 20 FPS max
two-way audio available via optional AI Theta Audio accessory (not built-in)

home_assistant.notes: Native UniFi Protect integration. Requires UniFi Protect console.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/RTSP profile with RTSPS URL from UniFi Protect. Requires Protect RTSP stream enabled per camera.
